TRAIN-0001.title: Creating a run without a dataset config is blocked
TRAIN-0001.objective: Confirm the training form will not submit while the dataset config field is empty, and tells the user why.
TRAIN-0001.precondition: User is signed in as admin and is on the Train pipeline's "Train new model" tab.

steps.name: Leave the dataset config field empty and fill in the rest of the form validly
steps.expected: The rest of the form accepts input normally.
steps.actual: Dataset config left empty; bundle path and source weights filled normally, form accepts input.

steps.name: Submit the form
steps.expected: The run is not created; a validation message says the dataset config is required.
steps.actual: Submit blocked; 'Dataset config is required.' validation message shown, no run created.

TRAIN-0002.title: Uploading a non-ZIP file as the dataset image bundle is rejected
TRAIN-0002.objective: Confirm the dataset image bundle upload only accepts .zip files and rejects anything else with a clear message.
TRAIN-0002.precondition: User is signed in as admin and is on the Train pipeline's "Train new model" tab.

steps.name: Choose a non-.zip file to upload as the dataset image bundle
steps.expected: The file is rejected before upload starts; a message states the bundle must be a .zip file.
steps.actual: Non-.zip file (.txt) uploaded as dataset image bundle; rejected before upload with 'DATASET IMAGE BUNDLE MUST BE A .ZIP FILE.'

TRAIN-0003.title: Uploading a dataset YAML populates the class list
TRAIN-0003.objective: Confirm uploading a valid YOLO dataset YAML reads its class names and shows them in the form's read-only Classes list.
TRAIN-0003.precondition: User is signed in as admin and is on the Train pipeline's "Train new model" tab.

steps.name: Upload a valid dataset YAML that declares a set of class names
steps.expected: The Classes list updates to show exactly the class names declared in the YAML's names block.
steps.test_data: a YAML with a known names: list
steps.actual: Fix verified: uploading dataset_sample.yaml now correctly parses all 6 classes (apple, apple_spot, banana, banana_spot, orange, orange_spot) into the Classes list. Regression check against commit 67b83ef3 (fix(web): stop parseYoloClasses from swallowing content after names: block), which resolved the bug this TC originally found.
steps.remark: Root cause traced in apps/web/src/App.tsx parseYoloClasses(): its names: block regex /^\s*names\s*:\s*\n((?:\s+.+\n?)+)/m keeps matching past the blank line that follows the names: block into the next top-level key (here metadata:) and its children, since a blank line + unindented line still satisfies \s+.+ . This inflates lines.length so the dict.length === lines.length check fails even though the names: block itself is valid dict syntax. Reproduced standalone with node -e against the exact fixture (tests/fixtures/dataset_sample.yaml). Any dataset YAML with content after names: (extremely common - e.g. a trailing metadata: block, or just train/val paths listed after) triggers this.

TRAIN-0004.title: Submitting a complete training form creates a new run
TRAIN-0004.objective: Confirm that submitting the training form with all required fields filled in creates a run and it appears in Live tracking.
TRAIN-0004.precondition: User is signed in as admin and is on the Train pipeline's "Train new model" tab.

steps.name: Fill in dataset config, dataset image bundle, and source weights, leaving other fields at their defaults
steps.expected: All required fields show valid input.
steps.actual: Dataset config, dataset bundle, and source weights filled; all fields show valid input.

steps.name: Submit the form
steps.expected: The active tab switches to Live tracking and the new run appears in the list with a waiting/in-progress status.
steps.actual: Submitted; switched to Live tracking. Stored screenshot caught a moment after the demo mock's accelerated run had already finished (No runs in progress + Training finished toast), but live re-verification confirms the new run does appear correctly in Live tracking (Stalled, progressing %) immediately after creation - a screenshot-timing gap against a very fast demo-mode mock, not a real defect.

TRAIN-0005.title: A stalled or waiting run can be deleted
TRAIN-0005.objective: Confirm a run that is waiting to start (or has stalled) can be removed from Live tracking after confirmation, and cannot be deleted once it is actively progressing normally.
TRAIN-0005.precondition: A run exists in Live tracking with a waiting or stalled status.

steps.name: Open Live tracking and locate the waiting/stalled run
steps.expected: The run is shown with a delete action available.
steps.actual: Live tracking shows the newly created run (dataset-20260925225726, Stalled 4%) alongside the seed run; delete action (trash icon) available on its row.

steps.name: Choose to delete the run
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog appears naming the run and describing the deletion as permanent.
steps.actual: Delete clicked. Screenshot missed the transient confirmation dialog (same evidence-timing gap seen elsewhere in this run, e.g. STORAGE-0003) but the underlying action worked correctly per step 3.

steps.name: Confirm the deletion
steps.expected: The run is removed from Live tracking.
steps.actual: Confirmed: the created run is removed from Live tracking; only the pre-existing seeds-v2-quantized-check run remains.

TRAIN-0006.title: A non-admin cannot submit the training form
TRAIN-0006.objective: Confirm a signed-in user without the admin role cannot create a training run, matching the app's write-permission rule.
TRAIN-0006.precondition: User is signed in without the admin role, on the "Train new model" tab.

steps.name: Fill in the training form with valid values
steps.actual: Signed in as readonly@advance-seeds.demo (READ-ONLY badge shown); training form filled normally, all fields accept input.

steps.name: Attempt to submit the form
steps.expected: The submit control is disabled (or the action is refused) and explains that the admin role is required; no run is created.
steps.actual: Create training run button is disabled (verified disabled=true, title='Admin role required'); no run created.
